title: Balloon Refinance Installment — Kestrel Advantage Balloon Calculation Standard
content:
When the balloon of a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract is refinanced, the installment is figured from three quantities.

**Amount refinanced.** The payoff amount on the payoff quote dated on the refinance date less every balloon payment posted on the refinance date, rounded to the cent. Where more than one payoff quote is dated the refinance date, the one issued first that day is used. Every other amount due is still paid separately before the refinance.

**Refinance APR.** The refinance APR for the contract's tier, from the balloon refinance terms schedule. Every rate adjustment that applies is added to or taken off that APR together, and the refinance APR is kept to two decimal places.

**Refinance term.** The longest refinance term for the contract's tier, from the same schedule.

**Refinance installment.** The level monthly payment that amortizes the amount refinanced over the refinance term at the refinance APR, rounded to the cent: the monthly rate is the refinance APR divided by 1200, and the installment is the amount refinanced times the monthly rate, divided by one less the reciprocal of one plus the monthly rate raised to the power of the term in months. The installment is figured after the APR has been fixed to two decimals.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| Payoff amount on the quote dated the refinance date | USD 21,250.00 |
| Balloon payments posted on the refinance date | USD 1,250.00 |
| Amount refinanced | USD 20,000.00 |
| Refinance APR | 6.00% |
| Term | 36 months |
| Monthly rate | 0.005 |
| Refinance installment | USD 608.44 |
